content.text:
This is a topographic map. The contour interval is 20 meters, index contours (heavy lines) are every 100 meters, and elevations are in meters. Ranger mission: choose the base camp from the magenta points C1, C2, C3 and C4. The site must meet all three rules: (1) it is below 400 m; (2) it is within 300 m of a stream (blue line), measured with the scale bar; (3) it is on gentle ground, where neighbouring contour lines are at least 100 m apart. Exactly one site meets all three rules. Which one? Answer with the site name, for example C2.

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

message.content:
C1 is below the 400 m contour, is within 300 m of a blue stream, and has neighbouring contours spaced at least 100 m apart. The other sites fail at least one of those conditions.

FINAL ANSWER: C1
